list.title: Homework
list.caption: Homework assigned across classes and sections
list.emptyExplanation: Homework you give to a section or a student shows up here.

detail.forbidden: You don't have permission to view this homework.

assignments.title: Who has this homework
assignments.help: Each row is one section or one student. Use Due date to move the due date; work already handed in stays. Use Change to give it to someone else.
assignments.caption: Sections and students who have this homework
assignments.emptyExplanation: Give this homework to a section or a student.
assignments.loadError: Could not load who has this homework.
assignments.capped: Only the first {{count}} rows are shown, active ones first. Older rows are not listed.
assignments.reassignDescription: The old row stays in the list as "Superseded". Work already handed in stays with the old row.
assignments.deactivateDescription: Students and parents will stop seeing it, and no one can hand it in. Work already handed in is kept. You can reactivate it later.
assignments.reactivateDescription: Students and parents will see it again, and can hand it in until the due date.
assignments.rowChanged: This row was already changed. The list is up to date now.
assignments.targetTaken: This homework is already assigned to that section or student. Pick another one, or change the row that is already there.

submissions.title: Check work · {{target}}

help.TICK: Tick each student who did the homework, then press Save.
help.PARTIAL: For each student pick Done, Partial or Not done, then press Save.
help.MARKS: Type each student's marks, from 0 to {{max}}, then press Save. Leave it empty if there are no marks yet.

submissions.emptyExplanation: Nobody is in this section yet, and no work was handed in.
submissions.loadError: Could not load the students' work.
submissions.notFound: This list cannot be opened. It may be for a section you do not teach.
submissions.saveChanged: This list changed while you were working. It is up to date now; check it and save again.

form.dueBeforeAssigned: Due date must be on or after the assigned date.
form.assignFailedAfterCreate: Homework was created, but assigning it failed. Try again from its detail page:
form.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
form.sectionWhatHint: Pick the class and subject, then write the task.
form.sectionWhoHint: Give it to a whole section or to one student.

gradingModeHelp.TICK: You mark each student done or not done.
gradingModeHelp.PARTIAL: You mark each student not done, partly done or done.
gradingModeHelp.MARKS: You give each student a mark.

upload.dropHint: Drag and drop files here, or choose files below. PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP, up to 5MB each, {{maxFiles}} files max.
upload.wrongType: Only PDF, JPG, PNG or WEBP files are allowed.
upload.tooLarge: Each file must be 5MB or smaller.
upload.tooMany: Only {{maxFiles}} files are allowed in total.

grid.marksInvalid: Marks must be a whole number from 0 to {{max}}.

template.title: 1. Download the template
template.explanation: Write one homework per row. Do not change the header row, and delete example row 2.

columns.class: The name of a class that exists in the current academic year, e.g. Class 5.
columns.section: A section of that class, e.g. A.
columns.subject: A subject name that already exists, e.g. Mathematics.
columns.due_date: Year-month-day, e.g. 2026-10-05. It cannot be before the date given.
columns.description: A short note about the task. You can leave it empty.

upload.title: 2. Upload your file
upload.explanation: CSV or XLSX, up to 5 MB.

preview.title: Preview
preview.subtitle_one: The first {{n}} row of your file will be added like this.
preview.subtitle_other: The first {{n}} rows of your file will be added like this.

result.title: 3. Result
result.partialSummary: {{success}} of {{total}} homework imported. {{errors}} rows had problems.

help.class: Which class the homework is for. It does not change later.
help.subject: One subject attached to the class. It does not change later.
help.title: A short name for the homework, for example Exercise 3.2.
help.gradingMode: Tick, partial completion or marks. Tick at the start. It does not change later.
help.target: A whole section, or one student.
help.section: A section of the class. Even to pick a student, pick the section first.
help.student: One student of the section. It shows only when giving to a student.
help.assignedDate: The date it is given. Today at the start.
help.dueDate: The date it must be done by. Seven days later at the start; not before the assigned date.
